annotation.title_clean: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 on intellectual property rights for the development of artificial intelligence technologies (2020/2015(INI))
annotation.title_en: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 on intellectual property rights for the development of artificial intelligence technologies (2020/2015(INI))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 404
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution on intellectual property rights for AI development. It calls for a harmonised EU regulation, an impact assessment of IPR and AI, human review in IP procedures, a distinction between AI-assisted and AI-generated creations, and rejects legal personality for AI. It only touches on transport, with no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a fully harmonised EU AI regulatory framework in the form of a regulation
Rejects granting legal personality to AI technologies
Distinguishes AI-assisted human creations from AI-generated creations; calls for evidence-based, technologically neutral approach
Requires human review in AI-based IPR registration and infringement decisions
Calls for an impact assessment of IPR protection in AI and support for SMEs and standardisation
